branding.title: Site branding and personalization
branding.description: Configure the browser title, site name, announcement, home copy, sign-in hint, and brand assets. Chinese and English are stored separately; administrator text is not translated automatically.
branding.mockNotice: Mock mode displays the defaults. Persistent settings and image uploads require the Remote API.
branding.readOnly: This account can view site branding but cannot save changes.
branding.loadFailed: Could not load site branding settings.
branding.saveFailed: Could not save site branding settings.
branding.resetFailed: Could not restore the default site branding.
branding.uploadFailed: Could not upload the brand asset.
branding.saved: Site branding settings were saved. Other open pages refresh within one minute.
branding.restored: Site copy and assets were restored to their defaults.
branding.uploaded: The image was uploaded. Save the settings to apply it to the site.
branding.quickDemoDisabled: Quick demo sign-in stays disabled. This setting cannot bypass authentication or reveal credentials.
